label: Guided Treasure Hunt
tooltip: The hand-run treasure hunt: it points you at spawn points and marks them off as you pass, but never moves your character.

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.tooltip: Track coffer spawn points and offer the guided hunt window.

observation_range.label: Observation range (yalms)
observation_range.tooltip: How close you have to get before a spawn point with nothing on it is judged empty. Coffers you actually see are recorded from any distance. The client only streams in coffers within a certain distance, so setting this too high marks spots empty that simply had not loaded yet.

auto_flag_next_target.label: Move the map flag automatically
auto_flag_next_target.tooltip: Move the flag on to the next spot as soon as the current one resolves, so a lap can be run without reopening the window.

confirmed_coffer_bias.label: Prefer confirmed coffers
confirmed_coffer_bias.tooltip: Multiplier on the distance of spots already known to hold a coffer when picking the next target. Below 1 favours banking what you have found over exploring; 1 treats both alike.

use_route_distances.label: Order by route distance
use_route_distances.tooltip: Order the plan by real navmesh distances from the zone's precomputed hunt graph instead of straight lines. Falls back to straight lines where no graph exists.

draw_spot_markers.label: Draw spawn point markers
draw_spot_markers.tooltip: Draw the spawn points in the world. The treasure radar can only draw coffers the client has already streamed in; this shows where to go before that.

draw_line_to_target.label: Draw a line to the target
draw_line_to_target.tooltip: Draw a line from you to the current target spot.

hide_markers_in_combat.label: Hide markers in combat
hide_markers_in_combat.tooltip: Stop drawing spawn point markers while you are in combat.

hide_resolved_spots.label: Hide finished spots
hide_resolved_spots.tooltip: Keep the table to what is left to do. Off by default, because watching a spot resolve is how you know the automatic check is working.

hide_spots_above_my_level.label: Hide spots above my Knowledge Level
hide_spots_above_my_level.tooltip: Drop spots ringed by mobs at or above your Knowledge Level from the table and from target selection. Those are the ones that will aggro on the way in.

announce_in_chat.label: Announce in chat
announce_in_chat.tooltip: Put each spot's outcome in the chat log as it resolves, so a lap can be run with the window closed.

reset_checks_on_respawn.label: Clear checks on a respawn wave
reset_checks_on_respawn.tooltip: When Treasure Sight reports more coffers than the previous reading, put the finished spots back to unchecked. Located coffers are left alone.

stale_reading_minutes.label: Treasure Sight reading goes stale after (minutes)
stale_reading_minutes.tooltip: How old a Treasure Sight reading may get before the counts derived from it are flagged as stale.
